title: A Polar Bear Swam for 9 Days Straight. 426 Miles, No Rest

scenes.text: A polar bear once swam nine days straight without stopping.
Scientists tracked her with a GPS collar off the coast of Alaska.
She covered 426 miles of freezing open water. The data show she never paused to rest or eat.
The sea ice had retreated far from shore, and she was searching for somewhere to land.
By the end, she had lost 22 percent of her body weight.
Nine days. Four hundred twenty-six miles. One bear that swam nine days straight.

description:
A polar bear swam nine days straight, 426 miles, without stopping.
US Geological Survey researchers tracked her by GPS collar in the Beaufort Sea. She was searching for sea ice and lost 22 percent of her body weight on the way.
Could you swim for even one hour? Tell us in the comments.
first_comment: Polar bears can swim for days, but they are not built for it. What animal would you pick to cross an ocean?
